criteria.rules: K1 guide-linked → N1 answer-box class → N2 same-formula family non-representative → N3 thin (tokens < MIN_LOGIC, or inputs < MIN_INPUTS and tokens < 2×MIN_LOGIC) → K2 ranked by score up to KEEP_MAX (rest N4). score = arithmetic/branch tokens + 4×inputs + unique-sentence words/100. See header of factory/gen-index-tiers.js.

ANSWER_BOX.unit conversion: length-conv weight-conv temp-conv volume-conv area-conv pressure-conv data-size-conv angle-conv height-conv torque-conv cooking-conv px-to-rem military-time-conv unix-timestamp-conv number-base-conv exchange-rate-conv
